candidats.titre: File:2007.06 - 'A close-up view in the excavation' - Amsterdam photos and pictures, Oosterdok Docklands with pile plants - on the background the Municipal Library, O.B.A.; Dutch city + geotag, Fons Heijnsbroek, The Netherlands (11292147744).jpg
candidats.description: 'A close-up view in the large excavation' - Amsterdam photos and pictures. A view in easterly direction over the long and sandy excavation-pit of the Oosterdok / Docklands area in Summer of 2007. Foundation activities with active pile plants and rusty sheet pilings along the railway embankment. To the upper right a construction of a temporary building-bridge. On the background in blue building dress the concrete construction of the new Municipal Library, O.B.A. of the city Amsterdam. Urban photography of pile sheeting, modern building techniques and construction sites in Amsterdam, The Netherl
